verdict.rationale: Codegen documents creating and managing many cloud agents through its API, SDK and CLI. Runs execute in isolated environments, and the docs refer to stopping "all related agents" for a PR, which implies several agents can be active at once. However, no evidence explicitly states that tasks run concurrently or describes how far parallel execution scales. Missing for 10: an explicit concurrency/parallel-execution claim, documented concurrency limits or quotas, fan-out orchestration guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of throughput at scale.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can run many agent tasks concurrently to scale delivery throughput

citations.quote: Create and manage AI agents that can write code, fix bugs, and handle development tasks across your repositories with full programmatic control over their execution and monitoring.
Ban all checks for a PR and stop all related agents.
Optionally filter by user_id to get only agent runs initiated by a specific user.
Use it to view agents, pull their work, create new agents, and run Claude Code with full telemetry and monitoring.
